title: Joplin Notes Sync Settings
description: Non-secret connection settings. Set your Joplin API token from the plugin's own page (Menu → Joplin Notes Sync) — it is stored as a local secret, never here.

joplinUrl.title: Joplin Web Clipper URL
joplinUrl.description: Base URL of Joplin's local Web Clipper API. Enable it in Joplin under Options → Web Clipper.

parentNotebookTitle.title: Parent notebook
parentNotebookTitle.description: Notebook created in Joplin to hold one sub-notebook per Super Productivity project.

syncIntervalSec.title: Auto-sync interval (seconds)
syncIntervalSec.description: How often to check for changed notes and push them to Joplin. Set to 0 to disable automatic sync (manual button only). Values under 15 are treated as 15.

syncTaskNotes.title: Sync task notes
syncTaskNotes.description: Sync each task's own Notes field (opened from the task itself) with a "Tasks" sub-notebook under the project. Two-way by default — edits in either app get pushed to the other, and if a task's notes changed in both places since the last sync, the more recently edited side wins. Enable "One-way task notes" below to make Super Productivity the only source of truth instead. Separate from the project's Notes tab, which is always synced one-way.

taskNotesOneWay.title: One-way task notes (Super Productivity → Joplin)
taskNotesOneWay.description: Only takes effect when "Sync task notes" is on. Makes task notes one-way, like project notes: edits made directly in Joplin are never pulled back into Super Productivity and get overwritten by Super Productivity's content on the next sync.

syncTaskTags.title: Sync task tags
syncTaskTags.description: Only takes effect when "Sync task notes" is on. Sets each task's Joplin note to have the same Joplin tags as the task's Super Productivity tags. Always one-way (Super Productivity → Joplin) — Joplin-side tag changes are never read back.

archiveRemovedNotes.title: Archive removed notes instead of deleting
archiveRemovedNotes.description: When a note (or task note) no longer exists on the Super Productivity side, move its Joplin note into an "Archive" sub-notebook instead of deleting it outright.

syncProjectIcons.title: Sync project icons and colours
syncProjectIcons.description: Give each project's Joplin sub-notebook a custom icon: the project's icon glyph on a tile filled with the project's theme colour. One-way (Super Productivity → Joplin). Joplin has no notebook colour field, so the colour is carried inside the icon image. Only projects that have at least one note to sync get their icon. Turning this off later leaves icons already set in place.

syncTaskDueDates.title: Sync task due dates and done state
syncTaskDueDates.description: Only takes effect when "Sync task notes" is on. Turns each task's Joplin note into a real to-do: its due date is set as Joplin's own to-do due date, and its checkbox follows the task's done state (replacing the "[Done]" title prefix). Always one-way (Super Productivity → Joplin) — due date/done changes made directly in Joplin are never read back.

syncTaskSubtasks.title: Sync subtasks as a checklist
syncTaskSubtasks.description: Only takes effect when "Sync task notes" is on. Appends a checklist of each task's subtasks (with their done state) to the bottom of its Joplin note. Always one-way (Super Productivity → Joplin) and read-only in Joplin — it's regenerated from Super Productivity on every sync, so edits to the checklist itself in Joplin don't stick.

syncTaskTimeStats.title: Sync task time estimate/spent
syncTaskTimeStats.description: Only takes effect when "Sync task notes" is on. Appends a one-line time-tracking summary (time logged vs. estimated) to the bottom of each task's Joplin note. Always one-way (Super Productivity → Joplin).

syncProjectIndex.title: Sync a project task index note
syncProjectIndex.description: Only takes effect when "Sync task notes" is on. Creates an "Overview" note in each project's Joplin sub-notebook linking to every one of its task notes, as a table of contents. Always one-way (Super Productivity → Joplin) and regenerated in full on every sync.
